authority: User: maintain separate CPU/GPU versions while avoiding heavy ongoing CPU support; retain how to reproduce CPU-optimized execution during GPU-centered development.
approach: One logical trained model and shared learned weights/configuration, with separate device-specific execution backends. Avoid a separate ongoing CPU training track.

includes: typed restored learned weights and custody/provenance
CPU benchmark protocols and historical measurements
pinned external-runtime manifest and hardware/build metadata

cpu_optimization_recipe: Restore the same typed managed learned weights; preserve model equations, tied-weight transforms, normalization and uniform deployment quantization.
Use the archived fused contiguous C++/AVX learned transport and spatial kernels; keep scalar/AVX interpolation donor/sum order and boundary behavior.
Preserve learned-divisor tensor pressure execution and causal learned pressure-history composition; no numerical solver or analytical inverse in the candidate.
Use qualified coordinate-table construction for known external scene/time inputs.
Compile with the archived compiler/flags: C++17, -O3, -fPIC, -shared, -ffp-contract=off, -fno-fast-math, -march=native. Do not enable FMA or fast-math without separate precision qualification.
For CPU verification, start with the registered one-core policy; optionally reproduce2/4cores separately. Preserve every measured intermediate output and verify accuracy of the actual timed bytes.

definition.role: Untrained neural coordinate/sparse-stage execution prototype, no target claim
definition.arithmetic: AVX2 independent queries; strict floating-point order; raw staggered fields; learned CSR weights; no pressure inverse or native backtrace
prototype_initializers: neutral zero gates and inherited learned mixing
seeded nonnative gates and perturbed inherited mixing
definition.required_next_gate: Tensor/native operator and inherited-weight quantization checks, then full K1/2/3/4 block latency before new fits.
definition.implementation_change: Separate proven consecutive sampler loads with scalar row addresses from irregular gathers; unchanged weights, donor order, multiplication/addition order, clipping and full guards

cpu_reproduction_commands.cpu_execution_intent: These are explicit CPU reproduction commands, not routine GPU-development checks. They were recorded, not executed, during preservation.

reproducibility_limits: This is a source/weights/data/binary snapshot, not a self-contained runtime distribution. The external managed Python/Torch installation is not bundled; its copied manifest records versions, file hashes and absolute paths. Restore or requalify that environment when moving machines.

The archived native binary uses -march=native and the measured Intel Core Ultra9 275HX instruction set. Other CPU targets require a versioned rebuild, updated loader/build registration, accuracy checks and new timings; do not overwrite frozen artifacts or assume identical speed.
The existing system FFTW library is external and hash-pinned by the benchmark protocols.
This snapshot reproduces the current known-shape8/16cells-per-metre model. It does not establish CPU support for future architectures, expanded shapes or densities.
future_gpu_model_archive_requirements: Save architecture/source/configuration and portable typed learned weights, normalization, units, state layout, precision and deployment transforms.
Retain mathematical definitions of GPU-specific fused stages and representative complete input/output fixtures, so a CPU implementation can be rebuilt later.
Track CPU status per architecture explicitly: frozen validated backend, export-ready but unported, or separately requalified. GPU accuracy alone does not establish CPU readiness.

Keep routine fitting, forward qualification, accuracy evaluations and design timing on GPU. CPU porting/optimization is selective work when a CPU version is needed; no automatic CPU benchmark for every GPU candidate.
When making a CPU release, export the selected shared checkpoint, implement/fuse/profile CPU hot paths, and requalify every field/intermediate and autonomous rollout before labeling it CPU validated.
